column1: # Where a host points and whether a download may fetch from it.
# One table for the three implementations of the same rule:
# A redirect of a download is held to this table at every hop, so the three
# must never drift apart. Change a line here and all three tests follow.
# kind:       loopback, private, localname, tunnel, reserved, public,
#             or invalid (not an address a download can use at all)
# store:      yes or no, may a store build download from it
# acceptance: yes or no, may an acceptance build (feature abnahme) do so
